correctness.rationale: The classification is an exhaustive two-case partition by whether the independent side has an empty label. Necessity and sufficiency reduce to the exact neighborhoods of the clique and independent parts. Algebraic combination yields the stated polynomial. A literal checker exhausts 112896 labelings across all \(2\le r,n\le4\) profiles and matches every coefficient, the minimum coefficient, and the total count. The arbitrary-order theorem rests on the symbolic proof, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete coefficient-level census on a canonical nontrivial split family and simultaneously an explicit domination polynomial for its \(K_2\)-prism. It refines the scalar minimum, identifies a real \(n=2\) boundary in the number of extremizers, and supplies a reusable structural decomposition by empty-label location. This is more than a routine scalar substitution into known bounds.
